reviews.text: We’re grateful for your 5-star rating, Martie! It's wonderful to know you had a positive experience. We hope to see you and your pet again soon!
The staff here is top tier.  I highly recommend this vet to anyone seeking great animal care. My dog is always at ease once they come into the room and give her all the positive and loving attention.
Things are checked out first. The doctor will discuss everything with you then you have the option of what you want done to your fur baby. Dr. Walker is amazing.
Very caring staff and attention to the animals
Best place ! they love your pet as their own!
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Ed! We're glad you had a positive experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Great service

JUST EXCELLENT. THE WHOLE TEAM AND Dr. CHERLY WERE EXCELLENT AND SWEET. A PLEASANT EXPERIENCE AND AN EXCELLENT TEAM, VERY PROFESSIONAL AND LOVING WITH MY PRINCESS. HER RECOVERY WAS VERY FAST... 100% RECOMMENDED

We are absolutely happy at how great our cats medical care is provided since we changed over to the Balboa Veterinary Hospital.  Outstanding service, highly experienced and caring Veterinarians, and Veterinary support staff.  The facilities are very clean, and have that old time old school look and professional attitude.  They are very caring and loving to our cats. They provide the best of care and are very detailed in their examinations.  In plain words we have the best of confidence in our pets care.  We give them 6 stars out of 5 for sure.  Thank you.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive rating. Thank you for choosing us, Glenn!
Thanks for taking care of our Duke. Great staff.

BEWARE!!! This is from a few weeks ago but I felt the need to make sure people were aware before choosing a vet. I was going to bring my precious poodle here for a concerning behavior she was exhibiting. Upon arrival I didn't see much parking but was relieved to find more parking in the rear of the building where there also appears to be a securely gated kennel/outdoor area for the animals. HOWEVER there was also a homeless man that appeared to be fully camped out on the property which is shared by an auto repair shop that was closed (for the day or indefinitely I'm not sure) that was screaming obscenities and appeared to be very aggressive and agitated. He definitely noticed me as several of his outbursts appeared to be directed right at me. Needless to say I got out of there quickly. Animal lovers beware. The kennel gates were not very tall and had I left my dog there I believe there's a good chance this man would have potentially had access to my baby. Not to mention I didn't even want to get out of my car to walk back to the front of the building. This man is behind the building well away from the view of the vet or anyone else for that matter. Scary situation, did not feel safe...

Update:

After my cat went over the bridge, I was petless until recently when I adopted a lovely male labradoodle. True to the great service I received previously with my cat, they welcomed Doc with great service and many scratches. Still a great vet hospital, and Dr. G is still the best.

I was referred to BVH when my previous vet's office closed, and I couldn't be more pleased. Everything is explained in detail, and the Dr. my cat sees is great with cats. Mine is a brat, but Dr. Gunderson is able to calm her right down. She is thorough and informative, and very interested in the well being of her furry patients. The fact that she has a number of her own cats helps, I'm sure. Very impressed with both the care and the ease with which I can schedule an appointment. Thanks BVH staff.

We are very thankful to have an affordable, caring, and thorough Vet in San Diego. We actually drive over 30 minutes to this location because the service we receive is well worth it. Thank you Balboa Vet for being exceptional! We appreciate you!
You guys are awesome. Thank you for loving my little grumpy Riley.

There is no one I trust more with my cats and dogs care than Dr. G and her staff. They are and have always been exceptional. We moved and still drive the 45+ minutes for our dogs and cats to receive care at this location. Every bit worth it. 10/10
The best veterinarian without a doubt, very good service and attention, they are very friendly and understanding, I loved it

They love animals and it shows in the care they take. Dr. Gunderson loved on our Archibald like he was her own. The prices are extremely reasonable and we plan to take our older cat there should she need it.
Very knowledgeable & expert care; the dog loves visiting Balboa Vet.
Thank you for the review, Sharon! :)

Balboa Veterinary Hospital has helped us keep 4 dogs and 2 cats healthy throughout their lifetime.  Dr Gunderson, Dr Walker and team have always given our family trustworthy advice and been very helpful with our pets' needs.
Thank you for the review, Sarah! :)

Always an amazing experience for both me and my cat who gets to eat churros during his visit! Very quick to help and easy to reach. Prices are reasonable and staff is friendly. I would definitely recommend this veterinary office. I also love that they have a specific room for cats.
I feel that Dr Walker & the vet technicians truly care about Cobra.  Dr Walker even emails me to inquire about Cobra's wellbeing.   I wouldn't trust Cobra with anyone else.
Fast,Clean & Priced right !

Thank you, Lacey, for your wonderful 5-star rating! We truly value your support and are delighted to hear that your experience was a positive one. Your feedback inspires us to maintain a balanced approach in everything we do.

There when we need them! They took care of us like 4 times! Our go to! Thanks! 🫡
We got seen on time. Everyone was very kind and attentive to myself and my dog!
I've always found this team very responsive, realistic, and professional when it comes to the care of our cherished cats. I would not consider anyone else when it comes to our cat's health.

This was my second visit to the veterinary clinic and I brought both of my dogs in to update their shots. Everyone was very helpful and extremely friendly. All my questions were answered.  My first visit to the clinic was to put my 15 year old Yorkie down. The vet was so comforting and thorough in how it would be done and what to expect that I was able to hold it together. I really, really appreciated all that she did to get me through this devastating time.
